verdict.rationale: Brex is a spend-management platform that heavily uses AI (Brex AI, audit/review agents), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage policy for AI models. The AI feature descriptions, MCP server, and API token scopes are adjacent features and do not address training-data use.
